items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: It was the first real job I think was when my daddy took him off on the circus and he worked with me in California.

ctx.x: He still plays bass. Somebody said they heard him over there in Virginia.

But they don't play bass. Yeah. He was playing. He was playing around. He stopped playing the trombone. He didn't have no instruments to practice on. So, he started playing around here at these different bands and he worked this Jitney business. He worked under one of these Jitneys down there a long time. It was the first real job I think was when my daddy took him off on the circus and he worked with me in California. And, uh, when he came back, well, he went on the circus. He worked with Salesforce too. He used…
He's playing minstrel. He was on the minstrel.
